summary: Service recovery now runs through generic AgentCore PlanRun instead of a hand-coded workflow owner. The stub planner emits a full nginx recovery DAG with diagnostics, approval-gated restart, post-restart verification, and observation-grounded summary. The compatibility ServiceRecoveryWorkflow delegates to agent_core::service_recovery, and CLI audit-show now follows the latest dynamic AgentCore run id by default.

verification.result: AgentCore report returned restart_executed=true and final_health_ok=true
AgentCore report returned restart_executed=false and no restart effect was prepared
Timeline includes IntentReceived, PlanFrozen, PolicyEvaluated, ApprovalBound, EffectPrepared, EffectObserved, CommitSealed

acceptance.criterion: Existing service recovery happy-path tests pass through AgentCore.
acceptance.evidence: service_recovery::tests::happy_path_runs_diagnostics_restart_and_verified_summary calls ServiceRecoveryWorkflow, which delegates to AgentCoreServiceRecovery.

acceptance.criterion: Denied restart path prepares no restart effect.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::service_recovery::tests::denied_recovery_prepares_no_restart_effect and service_recovery::tests::denied_restart_path_prepares_no_restart_effect assert no EffectPrepared for restart-service.

acceptance.criterion: Audit timeline includes generic runtime events.
acceptance.evidence: Approved CLI demo audit-show latest includes IntentReceived, PlanFrozen, PolicyEvaluated, ApprovalBound, EffectPrepared, EffectObserved, and CommitSealed for the dynamic AgentCore run id.

acceptance.criterion: The final operator explanation is grounded in observations, not model claims.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::service_recovery::tests::final_explanation_is_grounded_in_observed_effects asserts the report summary uses observed tools and excludes model-claim language.

acceptance.criterion: No workflow-specific code bypasses AgentCore for tool execution.
acceptance.evidence: ServiceRecoveryWorkflow now converts compatibility inputs and delegates to AgentCoreServiceRecovery; hand-coded policy, sandbox, restart, and effect append orchestration was removed.

safety_ordering: Planner emits PlanSpec only; no side effects during planning
StepScheduler waits for CommitSealed diagnostics before restart-service
PolicyEvaluator pauses restart without approval and no EffectPrepared is written
Approved restart binds exact approval token before EffectPrepared
Post-restart verification steps are read-only AgentCore steps
Report is projected from EffectObserved audit summaries
